names.note: Read out of the title on his name link behind the company's line for 31 октября ст. ст., «Иаков (Блатов), мч.», with the rank word left off. The line itself gives the forename in the genitive, «Иакова», and no surname. The link gives no grade and no state of life, and none is read into the folder.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru prints «(1937)» after the line of ten people he is the last of. Nothing else on the calendar dates him: no life page follows his name, and his name page carries two days and no text.

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Всеволода , Александра , Сергия и Алексия и Василия , Петра , Василия пресвитеров, прмч. Анатолия , Евфросина и мч. Иакова (1937).»
source.note: The line is the seventh of the day and names ten people with one year for all of them; his name is the last on it and carries the line's third rank word, «мч.», which governs him alone. The day carries one typikon sign only, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком», so no rank is recorded.

attestations.note: **He is the one layman on a line of nine clergy and monastics**, and the calendar says so only by the rank word it gives him: «мч.», martyr, against the «Сщмчч.» of the seven presbyters and the «прмч.» of the two monastics. The link adds the surname and nothing else — no grade, no trade, no state of life — so `types` holds `martyr` alone and the folder has no `office`. The surname «Блатов» returns no other folder in the corpus. The ten on this line are not recorded as a company: no page read says they were tried together, and sharing a day of death is not a relation. azbyka.ru answered 403 to this corpus's fetcher on the day he was read.
